purpose: Every bounded agent-directed game/computer-use opportunity becomes a durable, source-reviewable semantic trace and tracked codification obligation; control is an admitted last resort, not forbidden.

required: fresh existing control gates including input idle and scene/save/player queue

workflow: Evaluate available deterministic native/repository policies first
When insufficient, opt in to an ACTIVE game listener and explicit bounded agent-control session
Before each atomic action persist PREPARE with capture, target class, action, authority receipt, and the reviewed mechanic ID and fallback reason when known.
Only then enqueue via CooperativeScreenQueue.enqueue_effect, requiring exclusive screen ownership, fresh presence/idle probes, scene/target/queue validation and effect checkpoint
If user becomes active in any app, yield action behavior while retaining the session, pending step, and read-only listener
While waiting, passive reviewed observations can continue without focus or game effect; no automatic background daemon
After renewed inactivity, re-run fresh idle probes and scene/save/target validation before one remaining action
Persist QUEUE_STATUS, then separate independently observed OUTCOME; unknown/partial outcomes need reconciliation, never auto-replay
Every attempted action remains a tracked codification work item including failures and interrupted paths
Generate a bounded compact_handoff for new agents; no raw chat, keystrokes, screenshots, names or OS telemetry
After review, encode each validated lesson in its canonical repository policy/native owner and tests; link a receipt, independently verify code/CI/main/real game before closing

events.sequence: strict per-session monotonic one-writer seq and optimistic CAS before atomic write
events.outcome_requires: separate post-action capture, proof ref and interruption classification
events.codification_requires: reviewed distinct post-action outcome and module+test+commit+review references; receipt alone not merged proof

discovery.provenance: sanitized reviewed sensor/agent semantic record, never raw input or screenshot
discovery.timing: while admitted, while waiting for player, or during post-effect observation before codification receipt

events.dispatch_boundary: Persisted immediately before the gated callback. An absent marker on a legacy trace remains unknown.

prepare_attribution.reason_default: The session fallback reason is inherited when PREPARE supplies none.
prepare_attribution.identity: Explicit repository mechanic ID. Never infer identity from an action label, target class or goal.

mechanic_identification.scope: Append one reviewed classification to an unattributed prepared step before codification. Preserve the historical PREPARE and effect evidence.

pause_resume.human_activity: WAITING_FOR_USER, do not dispatch, do not close listener or computer-use session
pause_resume.idle: existing minimum 15000ms and two independent fresh probes before each effect, plus scene, save, queue, target and desktop lock checks
pause_resume.partial: NEEDS_RECONCILIATION; human/host must observe and rebuild remaining work
pause_resume.manual_control: human commands remain primary, no cancellation/reordering of player queue
pause_resume.listener: must already be activated explicitly; passive observations only from trusted read-only adapters
pause_resume.passive_observation_identity: Every CooperativeScreenQueue passive observation outcome includes effect_class PASSIVE_OBSERVATION + its own work_id; the runner never logs that as a gameplay QUEUE_STATUS or permits an action outcome on its strength.
pause_resume.listener_collection: AgentControlRunner.observe_while_paused enqueues only reviewed passive callbacks; record_semantic_discovery journals sanitized semantic findings to the active listener.

codification.obligation: 100 percent of controlled atomic steps must have an auditable proposed outcome and a successor module/test receipt; keep missed/uncertain work open
codification.successor_policy: Promote recurring safe decisions to EA tuning or exact-patch native script when evidenced; deterministic policy tests first; retain opt-in host fallback when genuinely necessary.
codification.merge_proof: external GitHub mainline/source readback required; event CODIFICATION_RECEIPT is only a submitted claim
codification.source_verification_gate: An actor-supplied CODIFICATION_RECEIPT is a claim only. Coverage reports source_verification_pending_total separately and never says a claimed commit is main-verified; provider mainline code+test readback is required.
codification.paged_work_items: control_discovery.codification_work_items(ledger, offset, limit<=8) returns EVERY attempted action, its observed outcome, discovered facts, pending source gate and regression requirements in small batches.
codification.native_recovery: Successful and negative assisted actions require deterministic source and regression work. Only product-owned decision and submit with a matching current native acknowledgement and effect can prove native resolution.
codification.development_path: Use the existing BetterInstincts evidence checkout, including its ignored listener journal. Use an authorized separate worktree when needed for source.
codification.product_path: Exact installed Sims build and the existing explicitly selected Mods root. Artifacts and native import are independently verified on Windows.
codification.projection: effect_trace exposes before, during and after, preserves fallback origin, and can never establish native resolution.

source_routing.known_owner: Returns domain, existing module and test references. A coded claim for attributed work references the current registry owner and remains independently unverified.
source_routing.unknown: Keep the trace visible and review the identity or source owner. Registry failure cannot erase evidence, grant control or close proof.

privacy.capture: only sanitized class/action identifiers and opaque provenance refs; never raw key/mouse events, screenshots, Sim names, user save paths, or external app content
privacy.storage: explicit active listener only, bounded repo-local dist/host-listener/<session_id>/control-discovery.json

role: HOST_LAB_ONLY for runner/listener; pure policy ledger is POLICY_ONLY
